answer: The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The delta holds work receipts rather than names, so the dawn of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
